title: lathyrus sandbergii
intro: Lathyrus sandbergii, commonly known as Sandberg's pea or Sandberg's lathyrus, is a perennial species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus sandbergii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer.
